stem.text: Two compounds X and Y react to produce compound Z. The reaction is reversible.
When X and Y are mixed together in a closed system a dynamic equilibrium is gradually established.
Which graph could represent the change in the rates of the forward and reverse reactions over time?

stem.alt: Key: dotted line = rate of forward reaction; dashed line = rate of reverse reaction.

A.alt: Graph of rate against time: forward rate (dotted) falls and levels off at a constant value; reverse rate (dashed) rises and levels off at a constant value below it.

B.alt: Graph of rate against time: forward rate (dotted) falls to near zero; reverse rate (dashed) rises to a peak and then falls to near zero.

C.alt: Graph of rate against time: forward rate (dotted) falls and reverse rate (dashed) rises, and both meet and level off at the same constant value.

D.alt: Graph of rate against time: forward rate (dotted) falls to near zero; reverse rate (dashed) rises from zero and levels off at a constant value.
